title: Continuous Quantum Feedback Control via Kraus-Parameterized Belief Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum feedback control requires acting on noisy continuous measurement records without direct access to the underlying quantum state. We propose Kraus-Parameterized Belief Reinforcement Learning, a pipeline in which a recurrent encoder, constrained to the Stiefel manifold, produces density-matrix estimates that are guaranteed positive-semidefinite and trace-normalized by construction, embedding quantum state geometry directly into the learning loop. A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) actor then maps these physically valid belief states to continuous control actions. On a simulated continuously monitored qubit, the resulting policy achieves stable feedback control, maintaining a measurement-conditioned belief fidelity of approximately 0.77-0.80 and exhibiting substantially lower return variance than a parameter-matched LSTM-history baseline across both nominal and out-of-distribution conditions. translated_title: 基于Kraus参数化信念强化学习的连续量子反馈控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15715v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：量子反馈控制需要在无法直接访问底层量子态的情况下，对嘈杂的连续测量记录进行作用。我们提出了Kraus参数化信念强化学习，这是一种流程，其中循环编码器被约束在Stiefel流形上，生成密度矩阵估计，这些估计通过构造保证是正半定且迹归一化的，从而将量子态几何直接嵌入学习循环中。随后，近端策略优化（PPO）演员将这些物理上有效的信念状态映射到连续控制动作。在模拟的连续监测量子比特上，所得策略实现了稳定的反馈控制，维持了测量条件信念保真度约为0.77-0.80，并且在名义和分布外条件下，相比参数匹配的LSTM历史基线，表现出显著更低的回报方差。尽管在原始目标保真度上的增益有限...
tldr: 本文提出了一种将量子态几何嵌入强化学习循环的新型方法，通过Kraus参数化信念状态实现稳定的连续量子反馈控制，在模拟量子比特上达到约0.77-0.80的信念保真度，并显著降低了回报方差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel method embedding quantum state geometry into the reinforcement learning loop via Kraus-parameterized belief states, achieving stable continuous quantum feedback control on a simulated qubit with belief fidelity of approximately 0.77-0.80 and substantially reduced return variance.
